title: Experts disagree on new src/stage-isolation/stage-brief.ts
context:
Chief architect: both claims hold together; the reuse-only rule is already the design. The session id check is the one the design does not yet name, and the brief hands the helper shell commands built from host input.

Target: new src/stage-isolation/stage-brief.ts
- security-auditor: the session id taken from the hook payload is checked against a safe id pattern before it is placed into the SE_SESSION commands in the brief, and a hostile value drops the brief rather than handing the helper a shell command with injected text
- application-architect: the brief builder lives in the stage-isolation module and reuses MANDATORY_STAGE_AGENTS roles, loadFeatureDevelopmentPolicy and currentFeature/featureFilePath; it must not re-declare stage roles, pillar names or the workflow read lists
